reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 13 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Wizards.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 81 times in 100, by about 11; most games like this end between 199 and 247 total points.
